completed_gates: one highest-revision record per stable ID
formula tag and source-defect disclosure counts
archive, traversal, symlink, and disguised-archive exclusion
exact file-set, byte-count, hash, and manifest reconciliation
privacy_scope: The public self-validator contains only generic absolute-path and UUID checks for textual payloads. Binary-file and configured private-name and internal-routing checks were performed externally so their comparison strings are not embedded in this public set.
caveat: Automated package validation is not independent human peer review, mathematical certification, accessibility conformance, or rights clearance.
